title: Bound slow HTTP requests while preserving sync and long downloads
description:
Fork research: parallel GPT-6 Astra source reviews, 2026-10-25. Current application baseline: 3ae404b.

## Purpose and evidence

alebcay adds HTTP timeouts. Current http.Server has no ReadHeaderTimeout, IdleTimeout or endpoint request-body deadlines. This is distinct from closed #49 outbound limits and #51 sync writer isolation. Porting a blanket ten-second WriteTimeout would break large downloads or streaming, so use route-aware ingress protection.

## Acceptance criteria

- Configure finite header and idle timeouts and appropriate endpoint-specific body-read deadlines in addition to byte limits. Clearly document defaults and any operator settings.
- Bound slow API/torrent-upload bodies and release resources when clients stall, cancel or exceed limits. Preserve the existing authenticated handler chain.
- Preserve long-lived /sync, large ZIP/file responses and range downloads; do not apply a short global write timeout to these routes.
- Use real socket tests to show stalled headers and body uploads close within bounds while healthy sync and intentionally slow legitimate downloads continue beyond the short request deadline.

## Sources

- https://github.com/alebcay/cloud-torrent/blob/c7060a04998396fbc893643d6cb108f468ec706d/server/server.go#L179-L187
- https://github.com/jpillora/cloud-torrent/blob/3ae404b282d7678f90e16b0bf84a52d872fc73d9/server/server.go
- https://github.com/jpillora/cloud-torrent/blob/3ae404b282d7678f90e16b0bf84a52d872fc73d9/server/api.go
- https://github.com/jpillora/cloud-torrent/blob/3ae404b282d7678f90e16b0bf84a52d872fc73d9/server/sync_slow_test.go

## Scope

Implement within the existing Go engine, typed API, generated frontend models and authenticated handler chain. Use isolated legal fixtures; never test against live downloads. This is a new backlog item, not a claim that the proposed behavior already exists.
